Name: Mushroom Bucket Hat Fix
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]I like the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23953]Mushroom Bucket Hat[/url] mod by FoxBride/BananaSlug15, but its most recent version throws errors and replaces the entire hats file instead of just the bucket hat. Since the permissions allow modification, I've made this fix, which does the following:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Removes the broken hair code (it was unnecessary anyway).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Improves the EditImage patch so that it no longer replaces every hat sprite.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Adds an update key so that players can be notified if there's an update to this version of the mod.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]All credit goes to BananaSlug15 for the sprites and original code. All Donation Points for this mod go to them.[/size]

[size=3]When installing this mod, if you have the original mod then make sure to overwrite all files in its folder with the files from this version![/size]

Manifest.Name: Mushroom Bucket Hat Fix
Manifest.Description: Changes Stardew Valley's default bucket hat to a mushroom version. Originally by Banana Slug.
Manifest.Author: Banana Slug; Suntooth
